days.title: Arctic Circle Landmarks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Polarkreis
stops.detail: Grímsey is located directly on the Arctic Circle, which runs through the island.

stops.name: Denkmal
stops.detail: One of the main attractions of the island is a monument indicating the course of the Arctic Circle, which cuts through the northern part of the island.

stops.name: Orbis et Globus
stops.detail: As a result, the artwork "Orbis et Globus", a sphere that is moved 14 m north every year, will be rolled into the sea.

stops.name: Wanderwegen
stops.detail: The interior of the island is crisscrossed by various hiking trails.

stops.name: Sandvík
stops.detail: The only village on Grímsey has a school, a shop for daily needs, a post office, a community center, an indoor swimming pool and a library in the northern district of Sandvík.

stops.detail: The island has the small Grímsey Airport (IATA code GRY, ICAO code BIGR), which is served by flights from Akureyri.

stops.detail: At the airport, a signpost indicates the distances to Reykjavík (325 km), London, Moscow, New York, Tokyo and Sydney.
